name: België / Belgique / Belgien

geography.notes: Use dated five-digit REFNIS for current communes with province/arrondissement/region, and NIS6 only as a distinct submunicipality namespace. Retain 2024/2025 merger aliases. Brussels bilingual names, Flanders, Wallonia, German-speaking eastern communes, rural Ardennes and the coast need explicit strata. Border trade with FR/NL/DE/LU requires independent market and POS-country evidence; .be and language do not prove country.

strategies.notes: Free Open Data is the proposed registry route, but registration and permitted-field/use admission are pending. Preserve enterprise and establishment-unit identities separately and activity-code vintage; neither proves current digital stock. Do not create accounts or use paid web services.

Public Search consultation is not the reusable Open Data route. Human-verification challenge remains respected; no bulk scraping. This is correlated with the KBO extract, not independent evidence of completeness.

Plan current and merged-locality names, including the German-speaking area and rural Ardennes. Licensed local OSM retail/repair POIs may supplement the grid; no public Nominatim systematic queries. Stock remains unknown until evidenced.

Follow official sector links for independent garages and authorised distribution. Sector pages are not themselves all member records; each directory discovered needs access review. Nonmembers and tiny independents stay eligible.

Motorcycle-specific sector entry prevents the car trade directory from standing in for all classes. FEDERMOTO covers category-L activities beyond current scope; quads/tricycles are not silently admitted.

Check Belgium versus Luxembourg outlet locations individually, preserve bilingual aliases and service-only flags. Manufacturer network coverage is partial and independent dealerships need other routes.
Keep seller accounts, entity/POS hypotheses and language surfaces separate. Limited research response proves neither absence nor automated access; specific category coverage needs evidence.

Complement specialist portals with whole-vehicle and camper classifieds. 2dehands/2ememain language labels do not create independent populations; private accounts are not automatically POS. No minimum stock rule.
Search official multilingual names and old municipality aliases while retaining one candidate evidence trail. Prioritise rural and low-observation localities without minimum ratings or stock.

Search owned and hosted dealership stock in three languages, including motorhome independents. Archive URLs only corroborate historical discovery; full-text recipes are not Common Crawl API requests. Domain/translation equality does not merge outlets.

Manual public professional referrals for web-less micro sellers, respecting login walls and automated-collection restrictions. Preserve language and claimed geography as evidence, never identity proof.

sources.access_notes: Public Nominatim forbids systematic locality/grid/all-POI queries. It is not an exhaustive discovery backend.

sources.title: Common Crawl URL index
sources.access_notes: Free URL archive index, not full-text search. Bound exact-domain lookups; bulk filtering belongs on local index data with resource budget. Archive results are historical leads.

sources.title: Meta explanation of automated collection restrictions
sources.access_notes: Prior permission is required for automated collection. This channel is manual public business-page lead review only, without account creation or login bypass.

blind_spots: Free KBO/BCE Open Data needs registration; paid Public Search Webservices and broader commercial files are outside execution. Public Search is not an open bulk substitute.
Legal enterprises and establishment units are distinct; active registry status or an activity code does not prove a selling POS.
Merged communes and bilingual Brussels/Flemish/Walloon aliases can both hide and duplicate leads; German-speaking eastern communities need their own queries.
Rural Ardennes, coastal localities and border exporters must remain visible when missing from locality imports.
TRAXIO and OEM channels omit nonmembers; motorhome independent/conversion and social-only sellers especially need local search.
One-vehicle and unknown-stock sellers remain eligible; three languages, public URLs and memberships do not establish complete country coverage.
